plan.notes: Transcribed 2026-11-14 from the official University of Washington Bothell degree-map PDF 'B-Applied-Computing-Degree-Map-2022.pdf' (printed footer 'Last updated: 09/22/2022'), hosted on uwb.edu. Filed under catalog_year 2022-2023: this is an ARCHIVED map, not the current catalog. The current UW Bothell catalog is 2026-2027, and the degree maps the site currently links to are UW NetID SharePoint Word documents and MyPlan, both login-walled; no login was attempted, so the public 2022 PDF is the newest publicly verifiable official term-by-term map for this program. The map calls itself 'a suggested schedule of courses based on degree requirements' and 'not a substitute for academic advising' (printed on the map). UW Bothell is a quarter-system school; the 12 blocks below are the map's 12 quarters (Autumn/Winter/Spring, Years 1-4) in printed order. The map prints no per-term totals and no degree total. No parenthetical credit number is printed anywhere on this map, so under the printed rule every slot is 5 credits, each quarter sums to 15 and the plan to 180, the standard UW Bothell bachelor's total. Markers printed on the map are disclosed, not recorded as prerequisites (the map prints no course-to-course prerequisite chain, so no prereqs are recorded): the filled diamond means 'Prerequisites: Must be completed prior to applying for a major' (printed on STMATH 124, B WRIT 134, CSS 142 + CSSSKL 142, B WRIT 135 and CSS 143 + CSSSKL 143); the open diamond means 'May be fulfilled with Discovery Core' (printed on the three Year 1 'A & H / SSc' slots). The map also prints competitive-applicant guidance (prerequisite GPA of 3.5, cumulative college GPA of 3.5, a well written personal statement, a positive grade trend), disclosed here and not encoded. Two printed cells combine a lecture and its skills lab in one 5-credit slot and are folded into the lecture entry with the combination disclosed on the course title: 'CSS 142 + CSSSKL 142' (Year 1 Winter) and 'CSS 143 + CSSSKL 143' (Year 1 Spring). The Year 3 Autumn slot prints 'CSS 340 / 342: Applied Algs / Data Structures' and is recorded as a choice slot with exactly those two printed options. The Year 2 Winter 'Statistics Course (RSN)' slot names no individual courses on this map, so it lists no options. Generic slots (A & H / SSc, General Elective, General Elective or 200/300-Level CSS Elective, General Elective/Minor/Minor Prerequisite, Areas of Inquiry Course, Minor Elective, 400-Level CSS Elective, 300+ Level Elective, General Elective or Additional CSS Elective) are transcribed with their printed wording as choice slots. The calculus slot is printed 'ST MATH 124' on this map and recorded as STMATH 124, the code form printed on the companion UW Bothell maps.
